name: Insilico Medicine and End-to-End AI Platforms
blurb: The company with the most advanced fully AI derived drug.
title: Insilico Medicine and End-to-End AI Platforms
answer: Insilico Medicine used AI both to choose the target, TNIK, and to design the molecule, rentosertib, for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Its phase 2a trial showed a gain in lung function against decline on placebo, published in Nature Medicine in 2025, and the company has moved the drug toward a phase 3 trial.

reading.body:
Insilico Medicine used AI to pick the target TNIK and design the molecule rentosertib, and its phase 2a trial in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis showed a lung function gain against placebo.

That is the strongest evidence so far that AI can carry a drug from target selection through molecule design into a human trial. The phase 2a result, published in Nature Medicine in 2025, measured a mean forced vital capacity rise of 98.4 mL on the top dose over 12 weeks, against a 20.3 mL decline on placebo. A separation of that size on a lung function measure is the kind of signal that moves a program forward, and the company has since announced initiation of a phase 3 trial.

The pattern matters for AI because it tests the whole chain, not one step. Most claims about AI in drug discovery rest on faster candidate generation, which shortens the front of the pipeline but says nothing about whether the chosen biology is right. Here the same system chose the target and the molecule, so a phase 3 result would be evidence about the method, not just about one compound.

What the data does not cover is the compute behind any of this. No model sizes, training runs, chip counts, or data center footprint appear, so nothing here speaks to the power and buildings constraint that governs AI at scale elsewhere. It also does not give success rates, cost, or timelines beyond the two dated events, and one drug is not a base rate. Phase 3 will show whether AI chosen targets hold up at scale. Until then, judge the approach on its speed to the clinic, which is proven, rather than on success rates, which are not yet.

explainer:
Insilico Medicine built an end to end platform: one system analyses biological data to propose new targets, another generates molecules against them, and a third helps plan trials. Rentosertib is the best known result. Its target, an enzyme called TNIK, was nominated by the company's target discovery AI as a driver of fibrosis, and the molecule was designed with its generative chemistry system.

Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is a progressive scarring of the lungs with few treatment options, so lung function measured as forced vital capacity is the key outcome. In the phase 2a trial, patients on the highest dose improved while those on placebo declined over 12 weeks. A phase 2a trial is small and short, so its main value is as a signal; the larger phase 3 trial will decide whether the drug works and is safe enough to approve.
